propositions: Cloud and Data Center identify users differently (Cloud uses opaque accountId, DC uses name), requiring a pinned identity contract abstraction
PR #120 hardcoded is_account_id=False and relied on an unset getattr attribute, causing Data Center to always return authoritative=False and trigger assignee-diff churn
A UserIdentityModel Protocol with resolve(local_value, remote_identity) and to_payload(value) implementations (AccountIdIdentity for Cloud, NameIdentity for DC) must unify the two identity strategies
NameIdentity must perform real lookup against DC's user-search endpoint to return authoritative=True and enable diff convergence, avoiding the churn class represented by epic ace2
An unresolvable assignee must raise BackendAssigneeNotFoundError rather than silently returning a non-authoritative value for both identity model implementations
Shared contract tests parameterized over both models must verify the 3-state resolution tuple (value, authoritative, is_account_id) and payload shape hold identically for each deployment
